{{Quote|Normally when there's no obvious culprit, as in this case, we let these things slide. But the murdered apprentice's master has demanded otherwise.|Zyn|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic" />}}
'''Necus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] who trained an [[Necus's apprentice|apprentice]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. When Necus's apprentice was [[Death/Legends|murdered]] in the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], Necus demanded that a full investigation be conducted.<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic" />

==Behind the scenes==
The murder of Necus's apprentice is the subject of a class mission for the Sith Inquisitor in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The Sith is unnamed in dialogue, but is named in a message that players receive if they expose Kayin's involvement. Inquisitor [[Zyn]] calls the apprentice's master a "powerful Darth," but the message contradicts this, providing simply the name "Lord Necus."<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic" />
